messages:
Sam (CS): Quick dump from the AcuityPay onboarding demo — recurring asks and a renewal signal. Tagging @Liz (Product) and @Mike (CSE).
Anna (Onboarding): Raw notes below from the call, keeping it terse.
Sam (CS): TL;DR bullets from the merchant: 
• Per-route cost visibility missing when using hybrid models — finance can't sign off on pilot.
• Onboarding: no sample prompts per connector (payments/invoices) — slows POC and increases support time.
• Reliability: when concurrency spikes they see 500s instead of graceful degraded model — customer said they'd pause rollout if this recurs.
• Ask: default fallback to smaller model + clear per-route billing breakdown in Console.
Mike (CSE): Can you share frequency/metrics? Is this reproducible on our side or only during demo traffic? If renewal is at risk we should mark this P0/P1.
Sam (CS): They saw ~12% error rate during a demo spike (concurrency >80). Exact quote from lead eng: "If we get those 500s again we can't go live this quarter." That felt like a clear renewal blocker.
Liz (Product): Proposed prioritization: fallback behavior = P0 (safety/regression), per-route cost visibility = P1 (enterprise decision), onboarding prompt packs = P2 (enablement). Thoughts?
Anna (Onboarding): For prompt packs — they want examples per connector (payments, invoices). I can assemble example prompts and sample responses. Temporary workaround: push a "starter prompt pack" doc and a copy-to-console snippet.
Mike (CSE): We already have a runtime flag in Dedicated: `model_fallback_policy`. We can expose it in Console as a toggle + default policy that routes to a compact variant. Short plan: (1) add toggle UI, (2) wire to routing policy to pick smaller model on overload, (3) telemetry to log fallback events. Quick CLI to add to tracker:
```/feedback add AcuityPay "fallback toggle + per-route visibility" priority:P0 account:AcuityPay```
Liz (Product): If Mike can prototype the toggle, we can ship an "experimental" Console feature (estimate ~2 weeks). Anna — can you collect sample prompts by EOD Tue? Sam — please paste the verbatim customer quote into the ticket for prioritization context.
Sam (CS): Verbatim: "When model errors happen during peak traffic we see 500s, can't explain costs, and we won't commit until there's graceful fallback and clear per-route cost." I'll paste the transcript and attach the demo recording to the ticket.
ProductBot: New ticket created: PROD-4521 — "AcuityPay: fallback toggle + visibility" assigned to Liz (Product), Mike (CSE). Link: https://redwood.atlassian/PROD-4521
Liz (Product): :thumbsup: I'll draft the PRD and include acceptance criteria and rollout plan. Mike — can you include cost/latency delta estimates for fallback in the ticket?
Mike (CSE): Yep. Preliminary numbers: compact fallback reduces GPU compute by ~35% (lower cost) but increases inference latency by ~60–150ms depending on seq length. I'll attach measured samples.
Sam (CS): This is actionable — please mark this thread as a handoff once the PRD + ticket updates are in. Thanks everyone.
Anna (Onboarding): On it — I'll upload the prompt pack and a sample copy-to-console snippet once collected.
